Kona 2.2.0

Kona 2.2 lets you put your presets in the order you actually want them.

New

  • Drag to reorder presets — drag presets in the Kona Library to arrange them, and the order is honored everywhere: the menu bar dropdown, the Library sidebar, and the "Activate on launch" picker in Settings
  • Move Up / Move Down — reorder from the keyboard with ⌘⌥↑ and ⌘⌥↓, alongside Duplicate and Delete

"Indefinite Wake" stays pinned at the top of the list and isn't reorderable. Your preset order is saved and restored across launches. Requires macOS 14 or later.

Kona 2.1.1

Kona 2.1.1 stabilizes the menu bar remaining time display, eliminating width jitter and icon shifting as seconds count down.

Fixed

  • Stable menu bar remaining time — the remaining time display now uses a fixed-width, monospaced-digit countdown sized precisely for 00:00:00 next to the cup icon. The menu bar icon and adjacent items no longer shift or jitter as digits change from second to second.

Requires macOS 14 or later.

Kona 2.1.0

Kona 2.1 makes Scheduled presets dependable across launches and shows their countdown in the menu bar.

New

  • Scheduled countdown — with "Show remaining time in menu bar" enabled, an active Scheduled preset now counts down to the end of today's window, just like timed presets

Fixed

  • Scheduled presets activate at launch — launching Kona inside a scheduled window now activates the preset immediately; previously a preset could appear checked while nothing kept the Mac awake
  • Stale "enabled" checkmarks from a previous run are cleared at launch

Under the hood

  • Kona's app logic now lives in a shared core with the Developer ID app as a thin shell around it

Requires macOS 14 or later.
